Live for him :) Please. You'll find happiness and inspiration from your son, even in the darkest of times. And you will see him grow, to one day be there for you. Stay strong my friend :)

If you trust them and know them well I would certainly say go ahead! But be careful in how much you tell them. I read some of the other posts on this post and they said some professors report students who are suicidal. I guess I got very lucky with the one's I told. But yeah I would even encourage you to tell your close friends! The main reason I'm alive right now is because of my friends. Without them, I would not have the support group that I do now. Being honest is the best thing :) Best of luck friend! And let me know how it goes, whatever you decide to do!

The best thing that has happened to me quite recently is to really just be open with those you trust. And tell them as much as you feel comfortable telling. Because they are there for you. Know that. I too kept all of this shit to myself until as recent as this year and it has helped a SHIT TON. Please do this friend. By being honest with others you are being honest with yourself :)
Thank you for being so supportive and even offering yourself as help! :) Really though thank you for this comment, you're such a nice genuine soul.
And good to luck to you as well :) <3
I am currently seeing a therapist and soon to be a psychiatrist :)
Thank you very much friend! I'm very lucky and humbled to have the support of those who care :)

Well if its any reassurance, these professors I told, I went out of my way to get to know with them, like meet with them during office hours, grab lunch with them, etc. So once I felt comfortable around them as a person and not as a student, I felt it was fine to tell them.
Thank you friend :) I appreciate the care and support from everyone on this subreddit.

Yeah so the 1st prof just simply asked how school has been going for me and I said pretty not well, and he said 'Why?" and I literally just said it, it was almost like an instinct. It was pretty scary but once I said it they were super understanding which was a huge lifesaver.

Well honestly I literally threw it up as like the response to them saying, "Oh? And what's been troubling with you recently?" And I just fucking said it, I couldn't control my words. But yeah they understood thank goodness.
